definitions.explanation: Describes someone with a strong, muscular build suggesting physical power. Often used for men with imposing physiques.

examples.japanese: {屈強|くっきょう}な⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧
{屈強|くっきょう}な⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{警備員|けいびいん}→警備員：09867_keibiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A burly security guard was standing there.

examples.japanese: {屈強|くっきょう}な⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}んでいた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: Muscular young men were carrying the luggage.

notes:
Describes the look of physical power, a big muscular build; usually of men.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {屈強|くっきょう}な⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧: a brawny man
- {屈強|くっきょう}な⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧: a powerful build
- {屈強|くっきょう}な⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧: strapping young men

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦たくましい→たくましい：06255_takumashii⟧: sturdy, strong — the everyday word, also of character
- ⟦がっしり→がっしり：19940_gasshiri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧: solidly built
- ⟦{頑健|がんけん}→頑健：09197_ganken⟧: robust — about health and endurance rather than looks
